name: eureka-fixture-library
description: Parametric retail fixture library and studio: 2D / 2.5D / 3D from one editable model.

scripts.build: rm -rf dist && mkdir -p dist && cp index.html dist/ && esbuild src/app.ts --bundle --minify --format=iife --outfile=dist/app.js
scripts.dev: mkdir -p dist && cp index.html dist/ && esbuild src/app.ts --bundle --format=iife --outfile=dist/app.js --servedir=dist --serve=8765
